evals.expected_output: A test notebook at Output/UnitTesting/test_snp_concur_indirect_expense_silver_to_gold.py with: inline createDataFrame covering all CASE branches (PCARD match, non-match, NULL), all COALESCE paths (first non-null, second non-null, all-null), no ADLS reads, no TODO placeholders, all asserts with exact pre-computed expected values
